description: This file defines the 'MidiPortWrapper' class, which provides a wrapper around MIDI device and port information, including methods for initialization, string representation, equality checks, and hash code computation.

classes.name: MidiPortWrapper
classes.description: Provides a wrapper for MIDI port and device information, facilitating string representation, equality checks, and port info retrieval.

methods.name: MidiPortWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI port wrapper with device info, port type, and port index.

methods.name: updateString
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the MIDI port wrapper based on device and port info.

methods.name: findPortInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the PortInfo object matching the stored port index and type.

methods.name: getPortIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the MIDI port.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns the MidiDeviceInfo associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MIDI port wrapper.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another MidiPortWrapper object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the MidiPortWrapper object.
